summary: Add bounded selected-page image input and exact visual provenance to QA V3, plus an explicit image-capability flag for custom OpenAI-compatible model profiles, without replacing existing analysis or question paths.
decision_refs: Active user goal: use an advanced model as the reference analyst while CRIP manages local evidence and review
Only lightweight locally selected pages enter the model request
Existing functions remain available and the architecture is introduced as a separate feature
approval_evidence: The user explicitly approved the management-first CRIP target, requested the bounded evidence loop, and instructed the agent to begin building the framework as a new feature without deleting existing functions.
known_limitations: Reference QA and QA V3 remain API-only; the browser has no Reference Run or Ask control yet.
Results and review decisions are returned and model calls are audited, but QA V3 does not yet persist a first-class answer/review object.
No live advanced-model request or fixed 15-question quality benchmark was run.
